title: Counterfactual, Per-Decision Bias Auditing for Automated Hiring: Localizing and Explaining Disparate Impact in Applicant Tracking Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on proposing and evaluating a per-decision bias auditing method (AIBF) for applicant tracking systems using tabular datasets (Adult and COMPAS). It does not deal with evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
